title: Ask to Evolve: A Unified Harness for Lifelong Embodied Navigation with Hybrid Action Space and Persistent Memory
why: EvoLife is a unified embodied navigation harness: hybrid action space, active help-seeking interaction, and persistent spatial memory that retains place-bound experience across visits (SPL rises on revisit). Non-weight harness retention of experience for later tasks — lifelong embodied agent harness.
mechanism: Persistent spatial memory + hybrid navigation/action interface + active interaction policy as retained harness components; experience from prior visits guides subsequent navigation without weight updates emphasized.

title: SkillHone: A Harness for Continual Agent Skill Evolution Through Persistent Decision History
why: SkillHone is an explicit harness for continual skill evolution: pairs skill revisions with evaluation-side practice feedback and persists structured decision history (diagnoses/revisions/evidence/outcomes) so later agents refine skills across sessions without rediscovering rationale — core non-weight skill-library RSI.
mechanism: Continual skill-evolution harness with persistent decision history; role-separated subagents run practice probes, propose revisions informed by prior decisions; evaluation-side evidence supplies acceptance feedback; cross-session retained skill artifacts.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: deep-research benchmarks without pre-integrated search stack; +15.8 GAIA / +3.2 WebWalkerQA-EN vs commercial deep-research agent; exceeds prior skill-evolution methods; internal tool-mediated analysis +18.8 avg accuracy across seven settings.

title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
why: MemSteer-Opt revises agent memory store, retrieval, and context construction from generated QA/evidence supervision without updating model parameters — closed-loop harness-level memory optimization with retained design changes.
mechanism: Synthetic evidence-grounded QA supervision from unlabeled user histories; MemSteer-Opt uses QA evaluation + failure diagnosis to revise memory store/retrieval/context construction (non-weight); supervision also feeds existing memory optimizers.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: ATM-Bench and RHELM; MemSteer-Opt vs Base-BM25 +13.4 Question Score (ATM) and +4.1/+6.6 RHELM accuracy; competitive with official-QA-guided optimization; new-user continued design optimization demos.

mechanism: Adaptive gameplaying harness generation (coding agent edits harness code around a decision model); per-game memory filesystem stores reusable harness/code/traces; later episodes seed from proven harness and adapt to source changes — non-weight harness RSI for playtesting.
